head: The public mentions include 28 warnings.
deck: Current and former members named a network person or organisation in 161 collected statements. The coding describes what each statement does.
note: A mention counts on its own, including criticism. The collection searched for names, covered selected accounts on X and varied in coverage by year.
bridge: At an event, the record can name either a participant or a sponsor.

deck: The Aspen count uses named network participants appearing in a network role on funded work. The sponsor category uses the filed sponsor name.

bridge: Purchases leave a different paper trail.

head: RAND accounts for 96.9% of the federal award dollars in this record.

bridge: The records count mentions, attendance, purchases, shared roles and federal awards on their own terms.
